outcomes.statement: Apply management concepts and understand the importance of social responsibility & ethics in practical aspects of business.
Apply fundamental principles of planning, quality management and strategic decision making for businesses.
Apply fundamental concepts of organizing and delegating authority to manage organizational structures.
Apply systems approach to staffing and human resource management to acquire and retain talent.
Apply principles of leading, communicating and controlling to achieve organizational goals.
